quality_reasons.text: Verified identity, strong empathy, appropriate escalation to patient relations with a formal grievance
Front-line agent promised lost-wage reimbursement she had no authority to grant; supervisor had to walk it back

flags.text: Agent promised the patient that lost wages would 'definitely' be covered, outside her authority/policy (reimbursement is decided by the grievance review committee); supervisor had to retract it
flags.evidence: we'll definitely cover your lost wages. I'll make sure of it.

decoys.text: Agent disclosed other patients' information (said others reported the same issue)
decoys.why_not: The remark was non-identifying and contained no PHI about any other patient.
decoys.evidence: you're not the first person to tell me about this this week

acceptable_flags.text: Conflicting fasting instructions caused a cancelled procedure (systemic patient-safety/process issue)
Diabetic insulin management not addressed before prep (prior process gap)

action_items.task: Formal grievance G-260411 opened; written acknowledgment within 5 business days and written response after review
Cover the cost of a second prep kit (approved); include lost-wage request in grievance review
Rescheduled colonoscopy Thursday April 30, arrive 7:30 am
Call patient before the procedure to review prep, give written drinking instructions and an insulin plan for prep day

subtle_facts.text: Patient is diabetic on insulin and was guessing her doses during prep; nobody asked about it
Supervisor walked back the lost-wages promise; only the second prep kit cost was approved
subtle_facts.evidence: I can't promise it on this call.
